en: 06 ONLINE: NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music inside the theme. Log in by scanning a QR code with the service's app (no password; the login stays on this computer, encrypted, and goes when you log out), then browse the day's recommendations, your liked songs and playlists, search the service from the header's search box, and play: a playlist becomes a foobar2000 playlist, with titles, artists and covers. It plays what your account may play, at the quality your account gets; nothing is decrypted or unlocked. The first time, the view installs a small local bridge (Node.js and the services' community libraries, about 160 MB) beside the foobar2000 profile; it runs only while foobar2000 does.

Playlist import (06 ONLINE › IMPORT, no account needed): paste a NetEase or QQ Music playlist link, or open a file (Exportify's CSV for Spotify, Spotify's own Playlist1.json, a CSV, or "artist - title" lines). The songs your library has become a foobar2000 playlist; the rest are written to a list of what is missing. With a Spotify app of your own (Premium required by Spotify) a Spotify link can be read directly.

Archive LAYOUT › ROOM: the cases stand in rows in a rendered room, the selected one lifted out with its cover. Five materials in 05 STYLE › DISPLAY: FROST, GLASS, WHITE and BLACKOUT (these two with a choice of lighting), and RHINE LAB, a frosted translucent case after the original (light mode).

Mini player (M, or MENU › Audio Archive › Mini player): a small always-on-top rack unit with the cover, the current lyric line or the track, level meters, seek, volume and the transport keys. Drag it anywhere; it remembers its corner; right-click for a black or a white unit (or one that follows light / dark). A double-click or ⤢ goes back to the full window.

05 STYLE in four tabs (CASE & COLOUR, TITLE TAG, DISPLAY, PRESETS). A preset is a whole look (case, scheme, mode, background, tag, font, wallpaper): eight come with the theme, and SAVE THIS LOOK keeps up to twelve of your own.
Archive right-click: add the album, track or folder to a playlist (a new or an existing one), and Properties (edit tags)…. Tracks can also be dragged onto a playlist in 02 PLAYLISTS.
A jump list of the shelves: click (or wheel over) the shelf name under the Archive.
The artist lookups can be switched off (Archive right-click › Artist file: look artists up online); cached files and your own artist.txt / artist.jpg still show (#52).
The light / dark switch in the bottom bar can be full, one button, or hidden (MENU › Audio Archive).

Mixed Chinese / Japanese / Korean and Latin text: letters and figures keep the interface font instead of falling back to the CJK font with the rest of the line, both sit on one baseline, and CJK is set slightly smaller and tighter.
The text size now reaches the playlist's own list too (Columns UI's fonts are switched with it).
The Simplified and Traditional Chinese interfaces are reworded in plain player language (曲库, 可视化, 唱片盒 …) instead of literal translations.
The Archive's top bar folds its controls into menus when the window is narrow; Compact top bar in the Archive's menu keeps it folded.
The NO LYRICS / SEARCHING notice is neutral; the accent is kept for a missing file.
05 STYLE, the artist page and 06 ONLINE's side rail scroll when the window is too low for them (#51).
Lyrics no longer run under the SOURCE switch.
The playlist's name always shows in its header; the figures beside it give way first.
A thin white line at the edge of some covers.
F11 did nothing on an installed copy (window.ps1 was not copied by the installer).
Uninstalling also removes the online bridge and its saved logins.
zh: 在线页（06 在线）：在主题里使用网易云音乐和 QQ 音乐。用对应 App 扫码登录（无需密码；登录信息只加密保存在这台电脑上，退出登录即删除），之后可以浏览每日推荐、我喜欢的音乐和歌单，用顶栏搜索框搜索该平台，并直接播放：歌单会成为一个 foobar2000 播放列表，带歌名、艺人和封面。能播放的就是你的账号本来能播放的内容，音质也取决于账号；不做任何解密或解锁。第一次使用时，这个页面会在 foobar2000 配置文件夹旁安装一个本地小服务（Node.js 和各平台的社区接口库，约 160 MB），只在 foobar2000 运行时工作。

歌单导入（06 在线 › 导入，无需账号）：粘贴网易云或 QQ 音乐的歌单链接，或者打开文件（Exportify 导出的 Spotify CSV、Spotify 自己的 Playlist1.json、CSV，或每行 “歌手 - 歌名”的文本）。曲库里有的歌会建成一个 foobar2000 播放列表，其余的写进缺失清单。如果你有自己的 Spotify 应用（Spotify 要求 Premium），也可以直接读取 Spotify 链接。
曲库 布局 › 展室：唱片盒成排立在渲染出来的展室里，选中的一张带着封面抬起。05 外观 › 显示 中有五种材质：磨砂、玻璃、纯白、墨黑 （后两种可选灯光），以及 RHINE LAB：仿照原版的磨砂半透明唱片盒（浅色模式）。
迷你播放器（按 M，或 菜单 › Audio Archive › 迷你播放器）：一个置顶的小机架面板，有封面、当前歌词或曲目、电平表、进度、音量和播放按键。可以拖到任何位置，并记住停靠的角落；右键可以选黑色或白色外观（也可以跟随深浅色）；双击或点 ⤢ 回到完整窗口。
外观页 05 外观 分成四页（唱片盒与配色、标签、显示、预设）。预设是一整套外观（唱片盒、配色、深浅色、背景、标签、字体、壁纸）：主题自带八套，保存当前外观 可以保存最多十二套你自己的。
曲库右键菜单：把专辑、曲目或文件夹添加到播放列表（新建或已有的），以及 属性（编辑标签）…。在 02 播放列表 中也可以把曲目拖到左侧的某个播放列表上。
排的跳转列表：点击曲库下方的排名称（或在上面滚动滚轮）。
可以关闭艺人资料的联网查找（曲库右键 › 艺人资料：联网查找）；已缓存的资料和你自己的 artist.txt / artist.jpg 仍然显示（#52）。
底栏的深浅色开关可以设为完整、单个按钮或隐藏（菜单 › Audio Archive）。
中西文混排：一行里的英文和数字保持界面字体，不再跟着整行换成中文字体；两者对齐到同一条基线，汉字略小、字距略紧。
字号设置现在也作用于播放列表本身（会同时切换 Columns UI 的字体）。
简体和繁体中文界面改用更直白的播放器用语（曲库、可视化、唱片盒 等），不再逐字直译。
窗口较窄时，曲库顶栏的选项会收进下拉菜单；曲库菜单里的 精简顶栏 可以让它一直保持收起。
歌词页的“无歌词 / 搜索中”提示改为中性色，强调色只留给文件丢失的警告。
窗口太矮时， 05 外观、艺人页和 06 在线 的侧栏可以滚动（#51）。
歌词不再压到 来源 开关下面。
播放列表标题栏里的名称始终显示，先让位的是旁边的统计数字。
部分封面边缘的一条白线。
安装版按 F11 没有反应（安装程序没有复制 window.ps1）。
卸载时会一并删除在线功能的本地服务和保存的登录信息。
